text:
Priya M: quick flag  restore-runner is getting AccessDenied on several archived DB snapshot restores from s3://redwood-archive-2023. Not widespread but 4/87 jobs failed in the last hour.
Dan H: seeing that too. Error: "NotAuthorizedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/old-cmk-111" on job restore-8342.
Alex: did we recently change any IAM role names or swap service accounts?
Priya M: we rolled an RBAC rename this morning: svc-restore -> svc-restore-main. I updated policies but did not touch existing KMS grants or key aliases.
encops-bot: Alert: 4 decrypt failures for key old-cmk-111 between 2025-11-10T14:02:10Z and 2025-11-10T14:04:30Z. Sample trace: 
```
2025-11-10T14:03:21Z restore-runner ERROR job=restore-8342 cause=AccessDenied kmsKey=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/old-cmk-111
CausedBy: NotAuthorizedException: User arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/svc-restore-main is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/old-cmk-111
```
Dan H: likely scenario: grants on the CMK reference the old principal arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/svc-restore which no longer exists. KMS grant grantee ARNs are immutable.
Alex: any cross-account grants involved? These snapshots were copied from a partner account in 2023; we used a cross-account grant at upload time.
Priya M: yes two of the failing snapshots were cross-account uploads. The grant grantee was arn:aws:iam::444333222:role/external-copy-role which we decommissioned last year. Those restores relied on a combination of key policy + grants.
sec-oncall: for mitigation we can: 1) recreate targeted grants with EncryptionContextSubset matching snapshot ids, 2) temporarily update key policy to allow svc-restore-main to Decrypt (audit heavy), or 3) run restores from an instance assuming the legacy role (not ideal).
Alex: prefer targeted CreateGrant calls. Keep constraints tight to encryptionContext for snapshot_id. Also set a retirement window and call retire-grant when done.
Dan H: I can run an inventory: list-grants for key old-cmk-111 and map GrantId -> GranteePrincipal -> Constraints. Will post results.
Dan H: inventory snippet (sanitized): 
```
GrantId: g-201  Grantee: arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/svc-restore  Constraints: {"EncryptionContextSubset":{"snapshot_id":"dbsnap-202311-22"}}
GrantId: g-202  Grantee: arn:aws:iam::444333222:role/external-copy-role  Constraints: {}
```
Priya M: ok go ahead and create two temporary grants scoped to the exact snapshot_ids for svc-restore-main and to the partner principal for cross-account restores if we need to replay. Add a retire-on timestamp 6h out.
encops-bot: Suggested command template: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id old-cmk-111 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/svc-restore-main --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"snapshot_id":"dbsnap-202311-22"} --name temp-restore-dbsnap-202311-22
```
Dan H: ran create-grant for dbsnap-202311-22 and dbsnap-202312-05. Returned GrantIds g-9001 and g-9002. I logged CloudTrail CreateGrant events and attached them to INC-2025-754.
Priya M: re-run restore jobs for those 4 failures in a controlled batch of 5 at a time.
Dan H: first two replays succeeded. I'll retire the temp grants after verification.
Alex: long-term actions: 1) add a preflight check to the RBAC rename playbook: query kms_grants for any grantee ARN matching renamed principals and block until grants are reconciled, 2) add an automated detector: find grants whose grantee principal no longer exists (cross-reference IAM), 3) ensure CloudTrail retention covers CreateGrant/RetireGrant for 90 days.
sec-oncall: compliance note: temporary grants are acceptable if we 1) keep tight constraints, 2) set explicit retirement and 3) record operator + justification in the incident ticket.
Priya M: I'll update the rename runbook to include a KMS-grant sweep and file a follow-up to scan all CMKs for orphaned grants (scheduled job). Also will add a checklist item to prefer key-policy + cross-account statements over per-role grants where practical.
Alex: consider adding an infra tool that can map snapshot metadata -> required encryption context and simulate a restore (dry-run) pre-rename to detect fallout.
Priya M: thanks. Current status: 4 failing -> 0 after targeted grants and replays. Will monitor metrics and close when CloudTrail shows retire-grant for g-9001/g-9002. :white_check_mark:
